name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.8 degrees north of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 17 times in 6 visits over 29 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 15 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 29 hours starting 2025-07-19, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 1.86 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
